title: STAT3D as a new image-tailored Xenium-based spatial transcriptomics tool for accurately dissecting the tumor microenvironment.
snippet: Spatial transcriptomics enables researchers to study gene expression within tumor microenvironments at single-cell resolution while preserving tissue architecture.
